0022600198.text: The Utah Jazz (1-8, 14th in the West, 0-4 on the road, on a seven-game losing streak) visit the Minnesota Timberwolves (7-3, 6th in the West, on a three-game winning streak) in the Jazz's 10th game of the season. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), while Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), Joan Beringer (fracture) and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise). The teams have not played each other yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Jazz lost the season series 1-3, including a 147-111 defeat in Minneapolis on March 18.
